messages:
sara: customer on Dedicated reports streaming request 'hangs' after emitting 2-4 tokens. direct to runtime works; behind nginx sidecar it stalls. repro attached.
aj: which go-sdk + runtime versions?
sara: go-sdk v0.10.1, runtime v1.8.2. nginx 1.23 as sidecar, chunked_transfer_encoding enabled, no gzip.
drew: can you paste logs / raw response? stack trace?
sara: minimal repro (Go):
```go
client := redwood.NewClient("$API_KEY")
resp, err := client.Stream(ctx, redwood.StreamParams{Model: "open-7b", Prompt: "echo hello"})
for chunk := range resp.Chunks() {
    fmt.Print(string(chunk.Data))
}
```
This prints a few tokens then stops. No client error, connection stays open.
sara: tcpdump from customer shows chunked pieces that split JSON tokens: first few raw chunks: "4\r\n{\"t", "12\r\next\": \"he", "15\r\nllo\"}\r\n0\r\n\r\n"
aj: interesting — net/http should reassemble chunked; are you seeing the raw wire before reassembly?
sara: yes, packet capture at proxy egress. curl -v to runtime (bypass proxy) returns a single stream. through proxy the chunks arrive split like above.
support-ryan: can you also confirm response headers from upstream and downstream (Content-Type, Transfer-Encoding, Connection)?
sara: upstream: Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8, Transfer-Encoding: chunked, Connection: keep-alive. downstream (to client) similar but nginx adds some extra chunking metadata.
drew: hypothesis: nginx or a filter is re-chunking and inserting boundaries inside JSON tokens. our Go client uses a bufio.Scanner with ScanLines/ScanBytes configured to look for newline-delimited JSON objects; if a proxy splits inside a token and there is no newline the scanner may block waiting for newline. also scanner has max token size 64k by default.
aj: two quick workarounds to recommend: 1) set upstream header to disable buffering: "X-Accel-Buffering: no" for nginx so it proxies raw stream without chunk reassembly; 2) use our SDK patch: switch from bufio.Scanner framing to incremental json.Decoder streaming (we have a branch).
sara: customer tried X-Accel-Buffering: no and stream resumed correctly — no more stalls.
support-ryan: for a short-term client-side mitigation ask them to increase scanner buffer: set bufio.NewScannerSize(scanner, 256*1024) or switch to custom reader. but better to use Decoder.
drew: creating internal issue: ISS-482 "go-sdk: use incremental json.Decoder for streaming responses to tolerate proxy chunking". assigning to eng-runtime.
infra-bot: deploy job queued for branch "fix/stream-decoder-iss482" — CI passed.
aj: customer asks for hotfix patch or instructions. sara, offer the nginx header + small client example as workaround and invite to apply patched client when released.
sara: offered workaround + config snippet:
```
# nginx location /api/stream {
  proxy_pass http://runtime;
  proxy_set_header X-Accel-Buffering no;
  proxy_buffering off;
}
```
customer applied header, reported stable streaming (:white_check_mark:).
drew: we'll include a KB article and update go-sdk README about framing pitfalls behind re-chunking proxies.
sara: closing with notes: repro steps, tcpdump snippet, nginx config, SDK issue number ISS-482. marking resolved. :thumbsup:
